claims.statement: A development agent can mechanically preflight actual target-relative proposal and logical-destination paths against an explicitly chosen repository from a separate implementation checkout or other working directory, without redundant directory-dependent failures.

attributes.title: Target-rooted proposal preflight

alignment.basis: Improve concrete returning development execution under ADR 0038.

ambition.basis: Remove mismatched front-end path check; reuse existing inspector.

horizon.basis: Actual #1023 failure and viable target-rooted inspector.

realization.basis: Actual hosted run 46108602938 at exact candidate ab056850 reproduced the prior #1023 failure using the genuine focused-evolution review, original digest and fixed pre-activation target af034081. Old target-relative invocation from the implementation checkout refused the existing target draft; old contained absolute and target-CWD relative calls agreed. Corrected detached preflight from implementation, target and unrelated directories, and contained absolute paths, returned the exact old correct complete payload, including one claim/four relations and absent destination. Actual ordinary pack relative/absolute preflight matched old correct payload (three claims/six relations); old unrelated-CWD relative invocation refused. Target-missing caller-present file, external absolute path, traversal, symlink and occupied destination refused. Target status, HEAD, actual draft digest and absent destination preserved. Six-path canonical co-design passed exact bytes, one Python parse and separate valid three-claim/five-relation pack.

history.basis: Candidate implementation; actual repair verification pending.

disposition_history.rationale: Actual detached review validation failed because CLI inspected caller directory; existing search recovered selected re-entry context, so choose concrete execution repair over further inventory expansion.

attributes.synthesis_basis: Pass raw path arguments to the existing target-rooted contained proposal inspector, instead of prematurely validating existence or file type in invocation directory.
attributes.value_hypothesis: A development agent can mechanically preflight actual target-relative proposal and logical-destination paths against an explicitly chosen repository from a separate implementation checkout or other working directory, without redundant directory-dependent failures.
attributes.revisit_when: Reconsider if actual target-relative validation differs by invocation directory, target-missing or unsafe files are accepted, or absolute/root-invoked preflight behavior changes.
attributes.counterevidence: Absolute paths or changing directory already provide a viable workaround. Only proposal-check argument validation is addressed; no cross-repository promotion, complete security guarantee, measured time saving or independent learning.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Actual repair of target-relative CLI path handling for one real detached review and one ordinary reviewed pack, on a fixed target with varied caller directories. No changed inspector semantics, measured time saving, complete security guarantee, independent cognition or new method adaptation.

value_frame.beneficiary: Returning development agent using separate implementation and target worktrees.
value_frame.criterion: Actual prior detached review preflight fails under old relative caller invocation; new relative/absolute and target/caller invocation payloads agree with old correct target invocation; actual ordinary pack and unsafe cases preserve guards.
value_frame.comparison_baseline: Old producer/preflight with manual cd or contained absolute path.
value_frame.expected_observation: Exact real target preflight from multiple caller directories, old failure reproduced, new target-missing/caller-present and unsafe/occupied paths refused.
value_frame.would_change_decision_if: Reconsider if actual target-relative validation differs by invocation directory, target-missing or unsafe files are accepted, or absolute/root-invoked preflight behavior changes.
value_frame.cost_and_downside: Minimal existing CLI boundary change; no validator or path policy change.
